purpose: Review a genuinely new issuer-level supply-chain disclosure domain without first opening annual-report PDFs, table values, candidate values, comparators or returns, and without confusing missing source admission with factor ineffectiveness.

repository_evidence.interpretation: The domain is not an old tested factor, but no accepted local point-in-time source contract contains it.

mandatory_source_admission_gate.gate_1_new_issuer_state: The route must observe issuer-specific business dependency rather than price, identity, missingness or an old factor transform.
mandatory_source_admission_gate.gate_2_exact_document_and_table_identity: Freeze annual-report document type, consolidated scope, disclosure version, exact table/line identity and units before any PDF or table value.
mandatory_source_admission_gate.gate_3_point_in_time_availability_and_re: Freeze first public timestamp, later correction/replacement handling and the first accepted signal session strictly after availability.
mandatory_source_admission_gate.gate_4_denominator_and_missing_semantics: Freeze reported percentage versus amount reconstruction, revenue or procurement denominator, anonymous/name-redacted rows, not-applicable, withheld and true-zero semantics.
mandatory_source_admission_gate.gate_5_full_2019_2023_coverage_and_mappi: Freeze issuer mapping, annual-report universe denominator, duplicate/version rules and complete finite partition manifest for the three development folds.
mandatory_source_admission_gate.pass_rule: All five gates must pass before formula, direction, extraction, PDF/table value, factor value, comparator or return is opened.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_top_five_customer_revenue_concentration
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Dependence of reported operating revenue on the five largest customers.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted local source freezes the point-in-time annual-report table, consolidated scope, percentage/amount denominator, redaction semantics, revisions and full 2019-2023 coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_top_five_supplier_purchase_concentration
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Dependence of reported procurement on the five largest suppliers.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The same document-version, denominator, redaction, mapping and full-history contract is absent for supplier purchase disclosures.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: customer_supplier_dependency_balance_or_joint_floor
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint dependence across customer and supplier sides.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Mean, product, minimum, imbalance or another joint operator would search combinations of two unadmitted components before either base source is frozen.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: customer_or_supplier_concentration_yoy_change
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: A level-versus-change and one-year-versus-multi-year search cannot precede exact versioned base-table admission.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: largest_partner_share_or_top_one_to_top_five_shape
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Dominance of the largest disclosed customer or supplier within the top-five bundle.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing top-one, top-three, top-five, Herfindahl, entropy or dominance ratios is a row-subset/operator family unless a source contract first proves stable per-partner rows and redaction semantics.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_product_or_geographic_revenue_concentration
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Dependence of issuer revenue on reported product or geographic segments.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Segment labels, reorganizations, consolidated eliminations, restatements, disclosure thresholds and complete historical table coverage are not frozen in any accepted local source.

scientific_interpretation.why_no_formula_or_direction: Freezing a ratio before table identity, denominator, revision and missing semantics would let observed document values determine the definition.
scientific_interpretation.acquisition_priority_if_a_separate_contr: c163_01 then c163_02; c163_06 remains a separate segment-table contract.

next_action: Record all six routes append-only and preserve 158/142. Campaign164 may continue offline from another genuinely new finite domain; c163_01 may advance only after a separate exact point-in-time annual-report table contract is accepted before values.
